fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-28
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-27 11:30 to 2026-10-28 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one new escalation.
- Fact: srs-rust#1497 makes `note delete` refuse a note that Relations point at, unless `--cascade` is passed. Today it reports success and silently removes every Relation to and from the note, which cuts the provenance of anything derived from a vignette. Why it matters: it is a breaking change to a command people run, and the ruling it executes (srs-rust#1025) covered records only; the reviewer found gates green and the diff within the ruling, and escalated because breaking CLI behaviour is reserved to you. Options: A flip the default (notes behave like records; callers add one flag); B ship only the reporting of removed Relations and keep the silent default; C leave it. Recommendation: A. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium, the PR waits on you (gate:owner-merge). Proposed decision c7a8e0a2 (group log).
Still waiting on you with no ruling: needs-input issues srs-rust#1380, #1198, #1132, srs#928 (and parked #683, #704); the three open exercises (6b).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified by the group this cycle. The two merged PRs that name decision 01cfb06e (srs-rust#1498, #1499) execute it, and it was ratified by you in the 2026-10-27 08:36 session. No proposed decision awaited assent on a merged PR, so no group session was held.

3. Done: 5 PRs merged, all gate:auto-merge, builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer, quorum comment present on each.
- srs-rust#1488 (a retired relation type no longer holds its key): mandate RFC-006 V5 step 1; approve on green a5e9576; merged 11:38.
- srs-rust#1489 (refuse relation-type re-key while Relations use the old key): mandate RFC-005 E1 / RFC-006 V5 / rfc-decision-5f8204bc; approve on green 02a9b60; merged 11:50.
- srs-rust#1499 (ADR-053 section 4 records the narrow per-code details union, #1493): mandate decision 01cfb06e; approve on green aa9c5c6; merged 16:39.
- srs-rust#1498 (ADR-011 and ADR-053 describe schemars use as it is in the tree): mandate decision 01cfb06e; approve on green c549430; merged 16:39.
- srs-rust#1500 (payload schemas $ref the canonical entity schemas, commit output envelope schema): mandate charter 00567bf1, non-normative tooling; approve on green 38886c1; merged 22:30.

4. Stuck or lost: seven group PRs open, one red gate, no claims to release.
- srs#981 (arrangement scenarios for move, outdent, insert, navigation): rejected on red `pr-classification`; the body needs a line `Mode: clear  Cell: <cell>  Door: 1`. The reviewer also flagged two storage-test failures the builder says occur on clean master, unproven against the last green master run. Needs the builder.
- srs#979 (RFC-043 [R19]/[R20] scenarios): approved on green b14c819, auto-merge, state unstable (checks still settling at the time of reading).
- srs#980 (RFC-043 [R7]/[R9]/[R10] scenarios): approved on green 50e4136; state blocked and no gate:auto-merge label seen.
- srs-rust#1487 (refuse field/type updates that would invalidate records, #1484): approved on green db5150c on 10-27 but now has a merge conflict; a base merge voids the quorum, so it needs the builder and a fresh review. Over a day with no push.
- srs-rust#1481 (run the RFC-043 arrangement fixture): gate:owner-merge, waits on your merge; your ruling c16c70c1 says it lands without the release.yml line. Its head moved since the 10-25 reject; I did not check whether the line is gone.
- srs-rust#1497: escalated (section 1), gate:owner-merge.
- srs-programme#305 (proposed decision on the arrangement fixture and container-literal allowlist, srs#977): behind base, no quorum comment yet.
Every merged PR has a quorum line; no empty reviewer findings lists on the merged PRs.

5. Budget: 5 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (counted from the PRs: clerk group-state reads 0 merged because the cycle rolled over at 11:30 and gives 5 open with room 5; 2 more open PRs are owner-merge and not counted). Pause state: running. The latest group report (10-27) has no 👍 yet; the one before it was acknowledged, so the group is not paused.
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2 (the escalation above, age 0 days, yours to decide, not the group's); the proposed decision inside srs-programme#305 once it merges. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: the queue is fed. Open issues labelled `ready` + `wg:third-party-ready` in srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web with no needs-input and not parked: 13 (srs-rust#1496, #1495, #1492, #1491, #1342, #1339, #1264, #861; srs#931, #911, #236; srs-vscode#155; srs-web#632). Some may already be served by merged PRs (for example #1342 by srs-rust#1499); not checked. Top 3 in the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs#236 (P0), srs-rust#861 (P1), srs-rust#1264 (P2, oldest). Open group PRs in flight: 7 (2 owner-merge). Budget left: 5. Queue fed for about 1 cycle (13 ready divided by 10). Waits on you: the decision on srs-rust#1497, the merge of srs-rust#1481, the four needs-input issues above. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-27 12:28 run (queue fed, 11 filed: rulings 8, conformance 3).
6b. Exercises: three open, none listed in the SemanticOps log. dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (input asked for: should relation list and context reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable" (non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed); 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: the spec contract and the schemas disagree on what a lifecycle state and a relation type must carry" (not in the last report; I did not read its input line). Build trigger: the group log holds 15 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: five merges in a day, four of them within five hours of review, with the reviewer catching red gates on its own pass; a rejection from a PR-body format check (srs#981) shows the Builder still does not have the classification line right, which could be a template line rather than a repeated review. Owner-merge PRs, not review, remain what waits longest (srs-rust#1481 is three days old). I1 for this cycle: I1 (measurement 74b7cd7d) was written after the cycle rolled over, so its window is 2026-10-28 11:30 to now: 0 of 0 merged PRs, no figure for the five above; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: One escalation was raised: srs-rust#1497 flips a CLI default (note delete) and the role boundary reserves breaking CLI behaviour for the owner; the reviewer escalated and labelled it gate:owner-merge. Searched the group log and SemanticOps log for an existing record on note delete: none. srs-rust#1481 is already covered by ruling c16c70c1, so no second record.
